info.name: API Reference Associated Persons events API

params.name: created_after
params.description: Filter events created after this date (limited to the last 30 days)

params.name: order_direction
params.description: Order direction of the events list `asc` or `desc` (default: `desc`)

params.name: version
params.description: API version of the events to return `v1` or `v2` (default: based on registered webhook endpoint versions)

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs:
Returns a list of `events` sorted by creation date, with the most recently created event appearing first. The event list includes data from up to the last 30 days.

Each `event`’s data is rendered according to the API version at the time of its creation, as specified by the `api_version` attribute in the event object, rather than the current API version.

Retrieve an `event` object. Events are available for up to 30 days.

The event’s data is rendered according to the API version at the time of its creation, as specified by the `api_version` attribute in the event object, rather than the current API version
Replays an event by creating new deliveries to all currently matching subscription endpoints. Each delivery performs a single attempt and does not trigger automatic retries.
